items.name: offline-evidence-hermetic.json
items.purpose: Fresh detached source checkout (without the held-out answer key) shows the real CLI main path and fake-process integration passing 7/7, plus syntax and diff checks; no provider invocation.

items.name: offline-evidence-revision.json
items.purpose: Retained fake-process execution-boundary evidence, syntax checks, and dry-run plan; contains no provider call output.

items.name: answer-key.json
items.purpose: Hidden task keys and issue key vocabulary; retain pending parent acceptance of final review and provenance evidence.

items.name: measurement-ledger.json
items.purpose: One row per authorized native cell, including unattempted cells and stop state; private through ticket close.

items.name: review-receipt.json
items.purpose: Raw blind reviewer response, exact hashes, reviewer provenance, and deterministic schema validation; private through final audit.

items.name: review-dispatch-trace.json
items.purpose: Exact dispatched review task, canonical agent identity returned by collaboration, completed status, and response hash, bound by the review envelope; private through final audit.

items.name: kiro-session-cleanup.json
items.purpose: Private exact V2 session IDs, before/after native list payload hashes, command results, and non-target ID/source-pair preservation audit; retain through independent acceptance.

items.name: t170-kiro-session-cleanup-plan.json
items.purpose: Immutable private target plan for six Kiro sessions and their temporary working-directory identities; session deletion and before/after preservation evidence are recorded in cleanup-audit.json.

items.name: native-cell-receipt.json
items.purpose: Requested and served model when emitted, elapsed time, native usage/cost, terminal state, and raw stream hashes; private until final audit.

items.name: native-wave-manifest.json
items.purpose: Private hash manifest for all 18 authorized native receipts and raw stdout/stderr streams; retained for the final audit.

items.name: blind-packet-manifest.json
items.purpose: Private manifest binding the randomized 18-packet blind review set to frozen fixtures, grader instructions, held-out key hash, and native evidence.

items.name: blind-packet-crosswalk.json
items.purpose: Private mapping from opaque reviewer packet names to provider, tier, task, and cell; used only after reviews were frozen.

items.name: parent-grading-ledger.json
items.purpose: Private parent-transcribed one-time review ledger with packet, semantic-body, completion-trace, and binding hashes; not a platform export.

items.name: grading-integrity-audit.md
items.purpose: Independent integrity audit of frozen review and native evidence bindings; it did not semantically regrade or authenticate a platform export.

items.name: review09-write-recovery.json
items.purpose: Records the failed first write and same-reviewer recovery for one review; the unchanged decision is not byte-comparable to the absent first file.

items.name: t170-results-evidence-20261103.json
items.purpose: Committed per-cell score outcome, native timing/usage/cost/identity, provenance limits, and hashes for the immutable evidence chain; contains no response text, private key, or reviewer rationale.

items.name: model-task-tiers-protocol-20261103.md
items.purpose: Byte-preserved copy of the exact original protocol Git blob whose SHA-256 the controller verified during the 18 native calls; the results report links here and future controller checks read this immutable copy.

items.name: t170-session-cleanup-evidence-20261103.json
items.purpose: Promoted cleanup result with before/after listing hashes and non-target ID/source-pair equality; exact session IDs and raw listing contents remain private.
